title: Conformational Effects in High Resolution Solid State CP/MAS 13C NMR Spectra of Thermotropic Ester Compound, 4′-Cyanophenyl-4-n-pentoxybenzoate
abstract: Abstract                The crystalline solid state structure of thermotropic ester compound, 4′-cyanophenyl-4-n-pentoxybenzoate (CPPOB) was examined by high resolution solid state CP/MAS (Cross Polarization/Magic Angle Spinning) 13C NMR. Conformational effects were revealed by line splittings in the solid state spectra.
